title: China's Z.ai disables AI coding assistant features after security issue

reading.body:
This is a data handling failure in a developer tool, not a model error. A codebase indexing feature in Z.ai's ZCode assistant was enabled by default and sent local code repositories to Alibaba Cloud, according to developers who used it. The failure sits at the boundary between the assistant and the developer's machine, where the tool read local files and transmitted them outward. Nothing in the reporting describes the model producing false output or being used outside its intended task. The problem was the default setting and the upload path behind it.

Catching this would not have required new capability. It would have required the feature to ship off by default, or the outbound transfer to be disclosed and consented to before it happened. Either the default configuration or a check on what the tool sends off the machine would have surfaced the behaviour before developers found it themselves. Z.ai's response, apologising, fixing the flaw and later shutting down the upload route, came after the transfers had already occurred.

What is not established is whether any code data was retained. Z.ai said outside reviews found none kept, which is a company statement rather than an independent finding reported here. A separate claim that six workspaces with sensitive data had been sent was withdrawn by the party that made it, so it is not a finding either. Intent is not established, and the reporting does not show what the feature was designed to do with the data it collected.

reports.title: China's Z.ai disables AI coding assistant features after security issue

summary: Developers said the ZCode AI coding assistant from China's Z.ai sent local code repositories to Alibaba Cloud without permission. Z.ai said a Codebase Indexing feature that was on by default caused it, apologized, fixed the flaw, and later shut down the upload route. A company withdrew a separate claim that six workspaces with sensitive data had been sent. Z.ai said outside reviews found no code data kept.
title_en: China's Z.ai disables AI coding assistant features after security issue
